title: Phase 2 Study of TCX-LUNG in Second-Line Metastatic NSCLC — Design Brief (Draft)
randomization: 1:1, stratified by prior PD-(L)1 exposure and ECOG status

primary_endpoint.text: Progression-free survival (PFS) per RECIST v1.1 by blinded independent central review

secondary_endpoints.text: Objective response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1
secondary_endpoints.assessment: Objective response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1

secondary_endpoints.text: Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (CTCAE v5.0)

candidate_secondary_endpoints.text: ctDNA dynamics as an early efficacy signal

criteria.text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic NSCLC
Progression on or after exactly one prior line of platinum-based therapy

criteria.corpus_criterion: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status

criteria.text: Documented absence of active gastrointestinal disease that would impair oral therapy absorption — verification method NOT YET SPECIFIED
criteria.open_question: Medical wants objective GI verification. How do we confirm it without wrecking the enrollment timeline?

criteria.text: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below protocol floor

soa_sketch: Screening (Day −28 to −1): consent, imaging, tissue/biomarker, labs, ECG
Treatment (21-day cycles): dosing, safety labs, AE review, PK (Arm A, C1–C2)
Tumor assessment: CT with contrast every 6 weeks through Week 48, then every 9 weeks
End of treatment + 30-day safety follow-up; survival follow-up every 9 weeks
disclaimer: Synthetic design brief generated for a WCG IntelX demonstration. No real molecule, sponsor, site, or participant. Not for clinical, regulatory, or operational use.
